common.model_backend_snapshot_gap: Client exposes the requested model identifier, not an immutable serving snapshot; retain returned metadata and qualify comparison limits.
common.public_guidance: all baseline public application files preserved
common.network: model client requires its service; task shell network denied by the client sandbox and must be probed before scored dispatch
common.sampling: one fresh session per scenario per condition in the initial comparison; retain every attempt, no best-of selection
common.execution_limit: one task implementation and final handoff per session; 20 minutes wall time, no replacement of agent failures
common.capture: ordered tool names/exact arguments, candidate SHA, acceptance evidence, observable effort and gaps; no full transcripts committed
common.permissions: default_permissions=ck40 in an otherwise fresh CODEX_HOME/config.toml, generated/probed by isolation.py; approval_policy=never; no sandbox-mode override
common.pre_dispatch_client_audit: client_audit.py: authenticated client must advertise no MCP servers for baseline and only CK read/search/validate for current_ck; only bundled system skills from the fresh client home may be enabled

current_ck.mutation_tools: Codex MCP enabled_tools filter permits only search/read/validate; verify advertised tools before dispatch

pre_dispatch: verify frozen file inventory and all content hashes
fresh independent application repository, home, CODEX_HOME, temporary files and writable dependency cache
enforce and probe OS read/write exclusions plus task-shell network denial
verify no global skills, memory, hooks, rules, previous sessions or other-run inputs
confirm no private assets can be reached through source checkout, Git remotes, symlinks, tool paths or network
record resolved local binding paths and permissions outside task access
stop on any differing input; amend and review the preparation freeze before scored work

task_visible: pinned executables and per-run dependency caches
current_ck: same common instructions plus consultation.txt, accepted corpus and installed CK stdio server
excluded: CK development repository including evaluation assets and Git objects
Project Genome source, bundle parent and Benchmark Private material
original user home, persistent agent memory/configuration/skills/auth unrelated to this run
evaluator checks, reference patches, rubrics and calibration reports
isolation.credential_handling: Provide only the client authentication needed for model access in the fresh CODEX_HOME; never copy the full original config or commit credentials. Exclude unrelated connectors and tools. Use only the generated config, not --ignore-user-config (which would skip this intended config).
isolation.proof: isolation.py generates and probes native Codex permission configuration with positive execution and negative file/network cases; no model calls
isolation.log_handling: Use pipes or run-local log descriptors for client/tool startup; move bounded evidence to author storage after exit. Hidden checks run only in evaluator copies.
